“Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city
to finish disobedience
and to make an end of sins
and to make reconciliation for iniquity
and to bring in everlasting righteousness
and to seal up vision and prophecy
and to anoint the most holy.
Seventy weeks have been fixed for your people and your holy town
to let wrongdoing be complete and sin come to its full limit
and for the clearing away of evil-doing and the coming in of eternal righteousness: so that the vision and the word of the prophet may be stamped as true
and to put the holy oil on a most holy place.
「那时，保佑你本国之民的天使长米迦勒必站起来，

for the Lord your God will be fighting for you.
